narrative: Global geopolitical friction and surging crude energy risks keep markets on edge — WTI advances to $102.90 while equities slide, driving safe-haven demand into JPY and CHF. USD/JPY holds near 156.89 as the Fed 4.00% vs BoJ 1.25% spread (+275bp) limits deeper downside, though options skew shows heavy put demand with 25d RR at −2.24. Broad sentiment remains defensive with gold lower -1.15%, equities -0.48%, DXY +0.22%, and VIX 20.0. Focus shifts to the upcoming Fed and BoC policy decisions on October 28.
